'''John Roberson The Emporer Lives''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[John Roberson]]
* '''Published:''' July 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' The Emporer Lives
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDag The Emporer Lives Roberson LS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Decklist ==

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
|-
| style="width:50%; vertical-align:top;" |
'''Character'''
* 1x [[Imperial Holotable]]
* 20x [[Visage of the Emperor]]
* 3x [[Reactor Terminal]]
* 3x [[There Is No Try]]
* 1x [[Tentacle]]
* 15x [[Counter Assault]]
* 5x [[Holonet Transmission]]
* 3x [[Fear]]

'''Location'''
* 1x [[Executor: Holotheatre]]
* 1x [[Death Star: Conference Room]]
* 1x [[Alters are stopped by Control and there is no try. The opponent can lose all this Force if he wants to!!! Just bring back another Terminal or Emperor. You'll almost always win by 10-15 cards because the opponent can't battle you! If he tries at the Holotable, you've got either 7 destiny counter assaults or massive Holograms to eat him up. Use Fear at the beginning to make it look like You're just trying to get rid of his cards quick. It usually makes for a long game! If he is grimtaashing you, use Tentacle and you'll eventually stop him from having any!!! Control is for when he's got Chewie or Obi with a Tatooine Utility Belt at the Cantina with a lightsaber draining you for 3 or 4 a turn. All you have to do is delay his onslaughts and use his own drains against him! works every time: -)]]
| style="width:50%; vertical-align:top;" |
'''Interrupt'''
* 3x [[Control]]
|}
